pictures.scene: Bierstadt, Sunrise — golden morning light coming across a wide valley with high cliffs standing over a river and dark trees along the banks, then i saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and earth had passed away, and the sea was no more
pictures.name: pd_bierstadt_sunrise

pictures.scene: Veronese, The Wedding at Cana — a wedding feast laid out on a terrace with christ haloed at the middle of the long white table and the guests crowded along it, servants carving at a balustrade above and musicians playing viols and lutes in the front, a white tower rising into the clouds behind, i saw the holy city, the new jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from god, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband
pictures.name: pd_veronese_the_wedding_at_cana

pictures.scene: Galla Placidia mosaic, The Good Shepherd — a mosaic of christ in gold and blue robes seated on a rock among his sheep with his hand reaching out to touch one of them, the hillside and the vault behind worked in small stones of deep blue and gold, and i heard a loud voice from the throne saying, behold, the dwelling place of god is with man, and he will dwell with them, they will be his people, and god himself will be with them as their god
pictures.name: pd_galla_placidia_the_good_shepherd_mosaic

pictures.scene: Hicks, The Peaceable Kingdom — a child in a white frilled dress with a red sash standing with her hand laid on a lion's mane among a lioness, a lamb, an ox, a goat and a leopard all gathered quietly together under a grapevine, he will wipe away every tear from their eyes, and there will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain, for the former things have passed away
pictures.name: pd_hicks_peaceable_kingdom

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Saint Matthew and the Angel — an old man with a heavy grey beard and a soft cap sitting in the dark with one hand at his beard and a quill in the other over an open book, the face of an angel lit faintly at his shoulder behind him, and the one seated on the throne said, behold, i make all things new, then he said, write this down, for these words are faithful and true
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_saint_matthew_and_the_angel

pictures.scene: Ruisdael, A Waterfall — white water pouring down over broken rocks between wooded banks with a green mountain and heavy cloud standing behind it, and he told me, it is done, i am the alpha and the omega, the beginning and the end, to the thirsty i will give freely from the spring of the water of life
pictures.name: pd_ruisdael_a_waterfall

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, The Return of the Prodigal Son — a father in a deep red cloak laying both hands on the shoulders of his ragged son, who kneels with his shaved head leaning against him, and onlookers standing half in shadow behind them, the one who overcomes will inherit all things, and i will be his god, and he will be my son
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_the_return_of_the_prodigal_son

pictures.scene: Dahl, Eruption of Vesuvius — the floor of a crater running with molten fire and thick yellow sulfurous smoke rolling up off it, one small figure standing at the edge of the glare on the right, but to the cowardly and unbelieving and abominable and murderers and sexually immoral and sorcerers and idolaters and all liars, their place will be in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur, this is the second death
pictures.name: pd_dahl_eruption_of_vesuvius

pictures.scene: Durer, The Seven Angels with the Trumpets — a woodcut of angels standing in a row blowing long trumpets around a draped altar, god enthroned above them in a ring of rays and ships burning on the sea below, then one of the seven angels with the seven bowls full of the seven final plagues came and said to me, come, i will show you the bride, the wife of the lamb
pictures.name: pd_durer_the_seven_angels_with_the_trumpets

pictures.scene: Friedrich, Morning in the Riesengebirge — a bare rocky summit with a crucifix set on it and a woman in white reaching back to help a man up the last rocks, range after range of blue mountains lying in the morning haze beyond, and he carried me away in the spirit to a mountain great and high, and showed me the holy city of jerusalem coming down out of heaven from god
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_morning_in_the_riesengebirge

pictures.scene: Church, Rainbow — a double rainbow standing over a snow peak with palms and green jungle below it and two tiny travellers following a stream track through the valley, shining with the glory of god, its radiance was like a most precious jewel, like a jasper, as clear as crystal
pictures.name: pd_church_rainbow

pictures.scene: Bauernfeind, Jerusalem Gate — a tall stone gate arch standing open over a crowded street in full sun, robed figures passing under it and a man leaning on a staff in the shade of the wall, the city had a great and high wall with twelve gates inscribed with the names of the twelve tribes of israel, and twelve angels at the gates
pictures.name: pd_bauernfeind_jerusalem_gate

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, Saint Peter Preaching — peter haloed, in blue and orange, standing with his hand raised in speech over a crowd of listeners seated close together, a green hill rising behind them, there were three gates on the east, three on the north, three on the south, and three on the west, the wall of the city had twelve foundations bearing the names of the twelve apostles of the lamb
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_saint_peter_preaching

pictures.scene: Christus, The Goldsmith — a goldsmith in a red robe holding up a pair of balance scales with a weight in the pan, the shelves behind him stacked with gold rings, loose stones, branches of coral and a convex mirror, the angel who spoke with me had a golden measuring rod to measure the city and its gates and walls
pictures.name: pd_christus_goldsmith

pictures.scene: Panini, Interior of Saint Peter's in Rome — a vast gilded barrel vault of deep coffers running away over a nave of marble piers, the baldachin and the dome standing at the far end and the people on the floor below reduced to small figures, the city lies foursquare, with its width the same as its length, and he measured the city with the rod, and all its dimensions were equal, 12,000 stadia in length and width and height
pictures.name: pd_panini_interior_of_saint_peters_rome

pictures.scene: Lear, Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives — the pale walled city lying along its ridge across a valley of olive trees, the long line of the wall running the whole width of the view in clear light, and he measured its wall to be 144 cubits, by the human measure the angel was using, the wall was made of jasper, and the city itself of pure gold, as pure as glass
pictures.name: pd_lear_jerusalem_from_the_mount_of_olives

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, Tabernacle of the Linaioli — the madonna enthroned in a blue mantle on a ground of beaten gold with the child standing on her knee holding a golden orb, the frame around them set with jewelled borders and panels of coloured inlay along the base, the foundations of the city walls were adorned with every kind of precious stone, the first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_tabernacle_of_the_linaioli

pictures.scene: Grunewald, The Concert of Angels — angels crowded together under an elaborate gilded canopy playing viols, and a crowned figure standing at the right inside a glory of orange light, the fifth sardonyx, the sixth carnelian, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst
pictures.name: pd_grunewald_the_concert_of_angels

pictures.scene: Springer, Cathedral Square — late golden light falling across the front of a cathedral with three great carved portals and down a broad paved street, market people and a cart standing small at the foot of it, and the twelve gates were twelve pearls, with each gate consisting of a single pearl, the main street of the city was pure gold, as clear as glass
pictures.name: pd_springer_kathedraal_plein

pictures.scene: Van Eyck, The Adoration of the Mystic Lamb — god almighty crowned and enthroned in red along the top of the panel with mary reading beside him and john the baptist at his other hand, and below them the lamb standing on the altar with the fountain of life in front of it and crowds coming in from both sides to adore, but i saw no temple in the city, because the lord god almighty and the lamb are its temple
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_the_adoration_of_the_mystic_lamb

pictures.scene: Hunt, The Light of the World — christ crowned, in a white robe and a red cloak, standing at night at a door grown over with weeds and holding up a lit lantern that throws the only light in the picture, and the city has no need of sun or moon to shine on it, because the glory of god illuminates the city, and the lamb is its lamp
pictures.name: pd_hunt_the_light_of_the_world

pictures.scene: Gossaert, The Adoration of the Kings — a king crowned and dressed in heavy gold brocade carrying a tall golden vessel in both hands, attendants in rich clothes standing with him against the brick of a ruined hall, by its light the nations will walk, and into it the kings of the earth will bring their glory
pictures.name: pd_gossaert_the_adoration_of_the_kings

pictures.scene: Bellini, Procession in the Piazza San Marco — the gold mosaic front of san marco with all its portals standing open, a long procession in white carrying a golden reliquary under a canopy across the wide pink pavement in front of it, its gates will never be shut at the end of the day, because there will be no night there, and into the city will be brought the glory and honor of the nations
pictures.name: pd_bellini_procession_piazza_san_marco

pictures.scene: Zurbaran, Agnus Dei — a white lamb lying on a grey stone slab with its legs bound together, lit against a plain black ground with nothing else in the picture at all, but nothing unclean will ever enter it, nor anyone who practices an abomination or a lie, but only those whose names are written in the lamb's book of life
pictures.name: pd_zurbaran_agnus_dei

lines.text: Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth,
for the first heaven and earth had passed away, and the sea was no more.
I saw the holy city, the new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God,
prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
And I heard a loud voice from the throne saying: Behold, the dwelling place of God is with man, and He will dwell with them.
They will be His people, and God Himself will be with them as their God.
He will wipe away every tear from their eyes,
and there will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain, for the former things have passed away.
And the One seated on the throne said, Behold, I make all things new.
Then He said, Write this down, for these words are faithful and true.
And He told me, It is done! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End.
To the thirsty I will give freely from the spring of the water of life.
The one who overcomes will inherit all things,
and I will be his God, and he will be My son.
But to the cowardly and unbelieving and abominable and murderers and sexually immoral and sorcerers and idolaters and all liars,
their place will be in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur. This is the second death.
Then one of the seven angels with the seven bowls full of the seven final plagues came and said to me,
Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb.
And he carried me away in the Spirit to a mountain great and high,
and showed me the holy city of Jerusalem coming down out of heaven from God,
shining with the glory of God.
Its radiance was like a most precious jewel, like a jasper, as clear as crystal.
The city had a great and high wall with twelve gates inscribed with the names of the twelve tribes of Israel,
and twelve angels at the gates.
There were three gates on the east, three on the north, three on the south, and three on the west.
The wall of the city had twelve foundations bearing the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
The angel who spoke with me had a golden measuring rod
to measure the city and its gates and walls.
The city lies foursquare, with its width the same as its length.
And he measured the city with the rod, and all its dimensions were equal, 12,000 stadia in length and width and height.
And he measured its wall to be 144 cubits, by the human measure the angel was using.
The wall was made of jasper, and the city itself of pure gold, as pure as glass.
The foundations of the city walls were adorned with every kind of precious stone:
The first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,
the fifth sardonyx, the sixth carnelian, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl,
the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst.
And the twelve gates were twelve pearls, with each gate consisting of a single pearl.
The main street of the city was pure gold, as clear as glass.
But I saw no temple in the city,
because the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.
And the city has no need of sun or moon to shine on it,
because the glory of God illuminates the city, and the Lamb is its lamp.
By its light the nations will walk,
and into it the kings of the earth will bring their glory.
Its gates will never be shut at the end of the day, because there will be no night there.
And into the city will be brought the glory and honor of the nations.
But nothing unclean will ever enter it, nor anyone who practices an abomination or a lie,
but only those whose names are written in the Lamb's Book of Life.
